name: Hadex D228A napájecí DC zdířka 2,1 mm do plošného spoje, vypínací kontakt
//: A 2.1 mm PCB-mount DC socket with a switching contact, as Hadex lists it (code D228A, EAN 8596425144945). The listing states a price, a stock date and nothing electrical: no current, no voltage, no maker, no drawing, no datasheet - only a photo. It was the only PCB-mount DC socket in Hadex's 31-product DC-connector subcategory on 2026-09-29, when it was read while researching the irrigation controller's 12 V inlet.
//why_not: States no current rating and no maker, and is not in stock until January 2027 - nothing to size a 2 A rail against.
footprint_note: Nothing to draw from: the listing has no drawing and no pin count.

body_mm.why_it_matters: every placement is arranged around it; the listing gives no dimensions

plug_id_mm.note: '2,1mm' in the product name is the plug bore it takes; the plug's outer diameter is not stated.

sourcing.note: '5,00 Kč' s DPH, '4,13 Kč' bez DPH; 3,00 Kč/ks at 10-99, 2,20 Kč/ks at 100+. 'Není skladem, vyrábí se, předpokládaný termín dodání: Leden 2027'.
